newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stocks end slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stocks end slightly higher.

text.p: Swiss shares followed U.S. markets higher late on Tuesday to close a mostly weak day slightly firmer in active trade, dealers said.
But they said the consolidation which began Monday was likely to continue for a few more days.
The broad SPI index was up 2.89 points to 2,486.55 and the blue-chip SMI up 4.3 to 3,892.6.
Roche, up 105 Swiss francs to 10,065, closed at all time high. Novartis merger partners Ciba and Sandoz were under some pressure but managed to close above the day's low.

Dealers said some investors were switching to Roche from Novartis. They said Roche drew some support from a presentation given by Zurich investment firm Pharma Vision which is heavily invested in Roche.
CS Holding firmed two to 136.75 francs on speculation that it was about to sell one of its subsidiaries such as Bank Leu or investment group CSFB.
CS routinely declines to comment on market speculation.
UBS, strong on Monday, fell 18 to 1,257 on profit taking.
Nestle fell five to 1,427 one day ahead of the food group's media conference where it will release 10-month figures.
Dealers said if Wednesday's conference produced news which did not live up to market expectation the share could nose dive and take the entire market along with it.
Insurers closed higher. Speculative buying helped Baloise, which rose 85 francs to 2,915.
Winterthur added five to 784. The company said it was granted a insurance licence for Shanghai.
